case.title: Feature request: Instagram booking button
case.subject: Feature idea
case.text:
Hi Slotwise,

Love the app. Would be amazing if clients could book directly from an Instagram 'Book now' button without leaving Instagram, and if you had a waitlist so clients get notified when a slot opens. Any plans for that?

Mia
case.why: Feature request: route to success, thank the customer, no roadmap promises. The booking page link can go in the Instagram bio today.

output.reply:
Hi Mia,

Thanks so much for the kind words and for sharing your ideas! I don't have any information about plans for an in-Instagram 'Book now' button or a waitlist with slot-opening notifications, so I can't say whether they're coming. I've noted your suggestion, and a teammate will follow up if there's anything to share.

In the meantime, you can add your Slotwise booking page link to your Instagram bio. You'll find it in Settings → Booking Page → Share. Clients tap the link to pick a service, staff member and time, though they will leave Instagram to do it.

Slotwise Support
